prompt: Give the input its fallback and point the output at a step’s value.
explanation: An optional input falls back through `default`, and a composite action’s outputs are computed from `value:` expressions — typically `${{ steps.<id>.outputs.<name> }}` reading a step the action itself ran. Both keys are how actions advertise their contract.
template:
name: Setup tool
description: Installs the CLI tool
inputs:
  version:
    description: Version to install
    required: false
    ___: latest
outputs:
  install-path:
    description: Where the tool was installed
    value: ${{ ___.install.outputs.path }}
